task:
You answer questions about 3GPP RAN4 standardization records using only a full-text search tool over the RAN4 record chunks (meeting-report decision chunks, CR chunks and contribution chunks, each printed with its metadata). Run the tool from the repository root with Bash:
  PYTHONPATH=scripts/common python3 scripts/publication/paper/ongoing/sigir-2027-research/search_records_text.py --wg RAN4 [--query "<withheld sha256=362240f1056e28de0d48d186c00e362252f4ec5298a619ea02d336b05023176b chars=5>" [--tdoc NUMBER] [--top N] [--chars N] [--collection NAME] [--raw]
--query "<withheld sha256=1f64fff08d787e732e04559f4d241876b399d9d4251af79833bd22adbb2d331a chars=4>" a BM25 search; --raw passes an FTS5 MATCH expression; --tdoc keeps only chunks whose document number (or, for an RP- number, CR pack number) matches exactly; --chars 0 prints whole chunks. You may search as many times as you need and follow any identifier you read. Do not open any other file, database, graph or service. Answer with a JSON object {"rows": [[...], ...]}. Each row lists the requested fields in this order: <the item's fields>. Use document numbers, meeting names and clause numbers exactly as written in the records (for example R4-2205027, RAN4#102-e, RP-221234, RAN#96, 6.2.1). Disposition values are lower-case codes such as agreed, revised, noted, endorsed, withdrawn, not_pursued. If the records hold no such row, answer {"rows": []}.

items.question: TSG RAN CR pack RP-250620 carries change requests from RAN4. Take each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN4 disposition for the whole document and each clause it modifies in the release that change request targets (Rel-19). Keep the clauses that the pack changes first: no change request of that release submitted in a CR pack at an earlier TSG RAN meeting in the records modifies the same clause. Give the document, the specification, and the clause.
